item.title: 2 Minute Medicine Rewind August 17, 2026
item.description: A study examines how reducing hepatic triglycerides short-term affects vascular health in adults with or at risk for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease.

item.title: Fast-spreading malaria parasite mutations in Uganda may weaken Africa's most widely used malaria therapy
item.description: New genetic mutations linked to malaria drug resistance have been identified in Uganda, potentially threatening the effectiveness of the continent's primary malaria treatment.

item.title: Does CKD Severity Predict Adverse ICU Outcomes?
item.description: In ICU patients, the presence and severity of chronic kidney disease are associated with higher mortality risk, particularly among those on maintenance dialysis.

item.title: Focusing on bodily sensations may dampen acute inflammation, human experiments suggest
item.description: New research suggests that how we attend to bodily sensations might influence biological processes, potentially reducing acute inflammation.
